invariants.expression: (x < 0 || x >= width || y < 0 || y >= height) ? result == null : true
invariants.rationale: If x or y are out of bounds, the method returns null; otherwise, this constraint does not apply.

invariants.expression: (x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height) ? result == cells[x][y] : true
invariants.rationale: If x and y are in bounds, the method returns cells[x][y]; otherwise, this constraint does not apply.
The method guarantees it never returns unless x is less than width (if not, it returns early).
The method guarantees it never returns unless y is less than height (if not, it returns early).
The method guarantees it never returns unless x and y are both non-negative (if not, it returns early).
